item.title: What AI Engineers Can Learn From Pilots
item.description:
Adam Field, who founded Crox and used to fly 737s, gave a talk at a Mindstone meetup in London last week about a plane crash in 1972. The crew were busy trying to fix a burnt-out landing gear bulb and didn’t notice that the autopilot had been knocked off and the plane was slowly descending.

He drew an analogy between that and AI. If the AI model is the bulb, we’re all so focused on stopping problems with the AI that we sometimes neglect the system around it.
